title: Calibre-Web
wrapper_note:
the upstream image starts s6-overlay as root and switches to its internal
"abc" user; TOS forbids root containers, so this entrypoint bypasses s6 and
starts Calibre-Web directly as uid 1000, moving its cache and log into the
mounted /config volume.
wrapper_note_readme: - **Entrypoint wrapper (privileges)**: the upstream image starts s6-overlay as root and drops to its internal `abc` user, which cannot work inside a non-root container. `src/entrypoint.sh` bypasses s6 and starts Calibre-Web directly as `1000:1000`, pointing its settings database, cache and log at the mounted `/config` volume. The application code under `/app` stays unmodified and read-only.
descript: Calibre-Web is a web app for browsing, reading and downloading eBooks from an existing Calibre library. It gives everyone on your network a clean browser interface: search and filter by author, series, tag or language, read EPUB/PDF in the browser or send books to an e-reader, and edit metadata or upload new titles when you allow it. This package runs the official Docker Hub image as a non-root container; the library and all settings live in the application data folder and survive restarts and updates.
release_note: 1. First release: Calibre-Web 0.6.27 from Docker Hub, running as a non-root container. The Calibre library and settings live in the application data folder and survive restarts and updates.
important: Requires DockerEngine. The image is pulled from Docker Hub at install time; add a registry mirror if Docker Hub is unreachable. Put your Calibre library (the folder with metadata.db) in DockerAppData/calibrewebdocker/books (use SSH/SFTP; the file manager cannot see DockerAppData), then set /books as the library path in the UI. First login: admin / admin123 - change the password immediately. Back up DockerAppData/calibrewebdocker before uninstalling with data removal. The app is plain HTTP on the LAN.

zh-cn.descript: Calibre-Web 是一个基于现有 Calibre 书库的电子书 Web 应用。它让局域网内的所有人都能用浏览器浏览、搜索和阅读电子书：按作者、系列、标签或语言筛选，在线阅读 EPUB/PDF 或推送到阅读器，也可以在授权后编辑元数据、上传新书。本应用使用 Docker Hub 官方镜像并以非 root 用户运行；书库与全部设置都保存在应用数据目录，重启和升级都不会丢失。
zh-cn.important: 需要 DockerEngine。安装时从 Docker Hub 拉取镜像；若无法访问 Docker Hub，请先在 DockerEngine 中配置镜像加速。请把 Calibre 书库（包含 metadata.db 的文件夹）放到 DockerAppData/calibrewebdocker/books（文件管理器看不到该目录，请用 SSH/SFTP），然后在网页里把书库路径设为 /books。初始账号 admin，密码 admin123，请立即修改。卸载并删除数据前请备份 DockerAppData/calibrewebdocker。应用通过局域网 HTTP 访问。
zh-cn.release_note: 1. 首个版本：Calibre-Web 0.6.27，来自 Docker Hub，以非 root 用户运行。书库与设置保存在应用数据目录，重启和升级不丢失。

zh-hk.descript: Calibre-Web 是一個以現有 Calibre 書庫為基礎的電子書 Web 應用。它讓局域網內所有人用瀏覽器瀏覽、搜尋和閱讀電子書：按作者、系列、標籤或語言篩選，在線閱讀 EPUB/PDF 或推送到閱讀器，也可在授權後編輯元資料、上傳新書。本應用使用 Docker Hub 官方鏡像並以非 root 使用者運行；書庫與全部設定都保存在應用資料目錄，重啟和升級都不會遺失。
zh-hk.important: 需要 DockerEngine。安裝時從 Docker Hub 拉取鏡像；若無法存取 Docker Hub，請先在 DockerEngine 中設定鏡像加速。請把 Calibre 書庫（包含 metadata.db 的資料夾）放到 DockerAppData/calibrewebdocker/books（檔案管理員看不到該目錄，請用 SSH/SFTP），然後在網頁把書庫路徑設為 /books。初始帳號 admin，密碼 admin123，請立即修改。解除安裝並刪除資料前請備份 DockerAppData/calibrewebdocker。應用透過局域網 HTTP 存取。
zh-hk.release_note: 1. 首個版本：Calibre-Web 0.6.27，來自 Docker Hub，以非 root 使用者運行。書庫與設定保存在應用資料目錄，重啟和升級不遺失。

data_notes: Everything persistent lives in two mounted folders: `config` holds the settings database (`app.db`), the Google Drive database (`gdrive.db`), the encryption key for stored service credentials (`.key`) and the thumbnail cache; `books` is the Calibre library itself - the folder that contains `metadata.db` and the ebook files Calibre-Web serves. Copying those two folders is a complete backup.
design_notes: **Runs as a non-root container.** The upstream image starts s6-overlay as root and switches to its internal `abc` user, which cannot happen inside a container already running as uid 1000. `src/entrypoint.sh` bypasses s6 and starts Calibre-Web directly, verified on real hardware as `1000:1000`.

**Cache and log stay in the data volume.** `CACHE_DIRECTORY=/config/cache` and `-o /dev/stdout` keep the read-only application directory under `/app` untouched; only the container-internal `/tmp` is used for transient files.
**Two volumes, one published port.** `config` keeps the application state, `books` is the Calibre library the user brings; only the web UI publishes a host port.
**Health check** probes `/` on container port 8083; Calibre-Web answers with a 302 to its login or first-run page, which `curl` treats as success.
**Fixed image tag, never `:latest`**, Docker Hub only, no `privileged`, no `network_mode: host`, no Docker socket.
limitations: Calibre-Web does not create a Calibre library. You must copy an existing library (the folder that contains `metadata.db` and the book files) into `DockerAppData/calibrewebdocker/books` before the first-run wizard can open it; `/books` is the path to enter in the UI.
TOS File Manager cannot browse `DockerAppData`, so the library has to be uploaded over SSH/SFTP or copied on the NAS itself.
The app is served over plain HTTP on the LAN. Do not expose the published port to the internet without a TLS reverse proxy.
One Calibre library per instance: the container mounts a single `books` folder and Calibre-Web is configured with one library path.
Book conversion and some optional features depend on tools shipped by the upstream image; they are used as-is and are not modified by this package.

runtime_files.purpose: settings, users, passwords and the configured Calibre library path (SQLite database)
runtime_files.growth: grows with settings and user accounts
runtime_files.lifecycle: never overwritten; back it up with the config folder

runtime_files.purpose: Google Drive integration database (empty unless that feature is used)
runtime_files.growth: only when Google Drive is configured
runtime_files.lifecycle: never overwritten; keep it with app.db

runtime_files.purpose: Fernet key used to encrypt stored service credentials
runtime_files.lifecycle: never overwritten; without it saved credentials can no longer be decrypted

runtime_files.purpose: generated book cover and thumbnail cache
runtime_files.growth: grows with the library, safe to delete

runtime_files.purpose: the Calibre library folder with metadata.db and the ebook files
runtime_files.lifecycle: owned by the user; back it up before uninstalling with data removal
